name: magic-ui-terminal
blurb: Terminal emulator with text typing animation, animating child content in sequence.
description: Terminal wrapper (Terminal, TypingAnimation, AnimatedSpan) simulating a CLI output. TypingAnimation character-by-character types a string at a configurable speed. AnimatedSpan fades in already-rendered lines. All animations can sequence (each waits for previous to complete) or run in parallel. Triggers on scroll into view by default.
use_when: Showing code examples, CLI commands, or installation workflows with a playful reveal animation.
avoid_when: Very long text (10,000+ characters); typing animation will run for a long time.
a11y: Text is rendered character-by-character into the DOM, so it's readable. No aria-live for animations — screen readers will hear the final text. startOnView requires scrollable context.
